basic_details.job_title: IGNFA Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 IT Associate, Technical Associate Posts
basic_details.post_name: IT Associate (Consultant 'A') - Network & Systems Security, Technical Associate - Hardware & Facilities IT
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.age_details: Must not have completed 65 years (as on the closing date)

qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree in Science or Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology from a recognised university with proficiency in basic Computer & IT enabled office skills, plus relevant experience (more than 3 years for IT Associate; minimum 1 year for Technical Associate), OR retired Government employee of the specified Level with more than 3 years' relevant experience.

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: (i) Master's degree in Science or Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology from a recognized university, with proficiency in basic Computer & IT enabled office skills; and (ii) relevant experience of more than 3 years (Annexure-2), or for a Ph.D. holder more than 1 year after notification of the Ph.D. result. OR Retired Government employee who held a post in Level 7 (Grade Pay Rs. 4,600/-) or above, with computer proficiency and more than 3 years' relevant experience. Experience required: More than 3 years of relevant experience counted as per Annexure-2; for a Ph.D. holder, more than 1 year after the date of notification of the Ph.D. result; retired Government employees need more than 3 years. Age limit: Must not have completed 65 years. Pay: ₹ 60,000 per month.

salary_details.pay_scale: Consolidated Rs. 60,000 per month (IT Associate) and Rs. 40,000 per month (Technical Associate)

pattern_table.Subject: Specialist skills required for the post

exam_pattern.details: Minimum 35 marks in the skill test is required to be interviewed If no candidate secures 35 marks in the skill test, the post shall be re-advertised

how_to_apply: Download the application form (Annexure-1) from https://www.ignfa.gov.in/recruitment.
Fill the prescribed form; a separate application is required for each post.
Attach self-attested copies of age, essential qualification (with date of result), experience (Annexure-2, Rule 4) and claimed certifications.
Send by post to OIC (IT), Indira Gandhi National Forest Academy, P.O. New Forest, Dehradun, Uttarakhand (248006).
Or e-mail to [email protected] as a single signed and scanned PDF not exceeding 10 MB.
Envelope or e-mail subject: Application for the post of IT Associate (Consultant 'A') or Application for the post of Technical Associate.
Make sure it reaches by 26 November 2026.
important_instructions: Applications must be received by 17:30 hrs on the closing date; if a holiday, the next working day Closing date will be notified as a calendar date on the IGNFA website A candidate may apply for both posts by separate applications No TA/DA for attending the skill test/interview or for joining False, forged or inflated documents lead to rejection and debarment from IGNFA for three years Results will be published on the IGNFA website and intimated by e-mail

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IGNFA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IGNFA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 IT Associate (Consultant 'A') - Network & Systems Security, 1 Technical Associate - Hardware & Facilities IT.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IGNFA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-1 of this advertisement, available at https://www.ignfa.gov.in/recruitment) and send it to OIC (IT), Indira Gandhi National Forest Academy, P.O. New Forest, Dehradun, Uttarakhand (248006), by post, or e-mail as a single signed and scanned pdf not exceeding 10 mb, to reach by 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is must not have completed 65 years (as on the closing date).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: ₹ 60,000 per month for IT Associate (Consultant 'A') - Network & Systems Security, ₹ 40,000 per month for Technical Associate - Hardware & Facilities IT.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's degree in Science or Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology from a recognised university with proficiency in basic Computer & IT enabled office skills, plus relevant experience (more than 3 years for IT Associate; minimum 1 year for Technical Associate), OR retired Government employee of the specified Level with more than 3 years' relevant experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open to eligible Indian nationals, including retired Government employees. Engagement is on a full-time basis; no other assignment without prior written approval. Attendance through biometric attendance system; working hours as for regular Government employees.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants who have completed 65 years on the closing date. Experience in software development, data entry, teaching, sales, BPO, DTP, web content, internships, academic projects or unpaid work is not counted. Part-time, freelance and self-employment experience is not counted.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligibility scrutiny by Scrutiny Committee. Shortlisting on marks if eligible applicants for a post exceed five. Verification of original documents on the day of the skill test. Practical skill test (70 marks).

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely contractual, temporary and non-official; no right to regular appointment. Initially 1 year, renewable yearly up to three years (1+1+1) subject to performance and funds. Continuation beyond three years for up to two additional years may be considered case-to-case.
